videos.headline: Jalen Hurts nearly throws pick-six leading to Titans' TD
Tank Bigsby lunges in for a TD
Jalen Hurts airs it out to DeVonta Smith for Eagles TD
Cam Ward dives into the end zone to pull the Titans even with the Eagles
Jalen Hurts connects with Darius Cooper in final seconds to give the Eagles the win
